name: Moholy-Nagy University of Art and Design
summary: Budapest art and design university: its nine bachelor's degrees are taught in Hungarian, and English starts at master's level.

handoff.label: Apply: bachelor's in Hungarian, master's in English

ib.text: Bachelor's degrees run in Hungarian, with state-funded places; only six master's programmes are taught in English, applied for on MOME's own portal.

notes: MOME's own pages say: "MOME offers 6 English-language MA programmes, the rest are available in Hungarian language only."
The Animation BA page shows Language: Hungarian; the admission guide for the nine bachelor's programmes is titled "in Hungarian".
